sideA.text: Player deck back. No printed text.

sideB.text:
PORTABLE ANTIVIRAL LAB

WHEN DOING THE MAKE SUPPLIES ACTION, DISCARD THIS CARD TO PUT 3 MORE SUPPLY CUBES ONTO YOUR CHARACTER CARD.
P6-02b

rules: Player card. The back is the Player deck back.
When doing the Make Supplies action, discard this card to put 3 more Supply cubes onto your Character card.
Discard, not destroy. The card stays in the Player deck cycle.
mechanics.notes: Printed code P6-02b. One of the three copies is added to the arriving player's hand. The other two go to the Player discard pile.
